title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When adding more features to a model, it can lead to overfitting. Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise along with the underlying pattern. This results in a low training error but a high testing error.

title: Effect of Regularization
text: Regularization techniques, such as increasing the regularizer parameter \(\lambda\), can help reduce overfitting by penalizing large coefficients in the model. This can lead to a more generalized model with better performance on unseen data.

hintAnswer: Training error decreases, testing error increases.
title: Identifying Overfitting
text: What happens to the training and testing errors when a model is overfitting?
choices: Training error decreases, testing error increases.
Training error increases, testing error decreases.

hintAnswer: It reduces overfitting by penalizing large coefficients.
title: Role of Regularization
text: How does increasing the regularizer parameter \(\lambda\) affect the model?
choices: It reduces overfitting by penalizing large coefficients.
It increases overfitting by allowing larger coefficients.
It has no effect on overfitting.
It only affects the training error.
